facts.fact: 刑场上五十名萨多维亚俘虏跪在地上，双手反绑在背后。
facts.anchor: all fifty of them, kneeling on the ground, hands tied behind their backs

facts.fact: 凯德趁塔拉辛在大湾城期间摸清了强化安全法令的更多内容。
facts.anchor: I managed to learn more about the Enhanced Security Decree while you were in Grand Bight

facts.fact: 那条法令随时会被夜帝阿拉里克签署成法。
facts.anchor: Emperor Alaric is expected to sign it into law any day now

facts.fact: 女仆们传言桑西亚·奥西纳斯特死在流亡之地，鬼魂回城塞为儿子唱摇篮曲。
facts.anchor: They say Sancia Ossinast died wherever she ran away to and her shade returned to the Citadel to sing lullabies for her son

facts.fact: 阿拉里克一句仪式性演说都没讲，就让墨色刀锋四散飞出。
facts.anchor: Without uttering a single word of the ceremonial speech that was expected of him, Alaric sent the inky knives flying in all directions

facts.fact: 这大约是夜帝国境内最不具仪式感的一场处决，凯萨斯人一片哑然。
facts.anchor: It was perhaps the least ceremonial execution to have ever taken place within the Night Empire’s borders, leaving the Kesathese in stunned silence

facts.fact: 她的丈夫站在被她连累而死的人中间。
facts.anchor: Her husband, surrounded by the corpses of the people she had doomed.

facts.fact: 塔拉辛转身逃回那艘渡她穿过平原回城塞的飞艇。
facts.anchor: Talasyn turned and fled back to the airship that would ferry her across the plains to the Citadel
